text:
noah: Scheduling a short coordinated push tonight 22:30-23:00 UTC. Order: api -> runtime -> console -> router. Main risk: new runtime adds X-Runtime-Feature header that older routers will 400 on. Call blockers now.

anya: API: sha-api-5f9 ready. No migrations. Canary tests green in eu-staging.

pete: Runtime team: promoting rt-3.4.0-quant (sha-rt-340q). It emits X-Runtime-Feature:quant. Router must whitelist header or we should run runtime in compat mode. We have a compat binary sha-rt-331x ready.

deploybot: deploybot: planned wave 22:35 UTC. Sequence: api=sha-api-5f9,runtime=sha-rt-340q,console=sha-ui-31,router=sha-router-15. Canary: eu-only 1% for 15m then 10% for 5m. Prewarm step after api canary: /internal/prewarm for 4m. Auto-rollback enabled.

noah: Ops ask: can initial canary run against a single router cluster (router-standby) to limit blast radius? Also want 0.5% traffic slice.

deploybot: deploybot: will scope canary to cluster=router-standby,traffic=0.5% for first 15m.

anya: Console: small copy + telemetry mute. FEATURE_BETA=false during canary. Release notes pushed.

sre-watch: Staging smoke: all checks OK. p99 api 98ms, p99 runtime 165ms. Dashboards linked.

pete: If router whitelist can't be applied within 8 minutes after runtime canary finished, fallback = pin runtime to sha-rt-331x and hold router promotion. We'll coordinate a fast rollback if needed.

noah: Rollback rules (condensed):
- error rate >0.9% for 3m OR
- p99 latency >1.9s for 3m OR
- prewarm failure or healthcheck flaps >3 in 5m.
If you need immediate rollback post the start, reply exactly "rollback" in this thread. deploybot will execute wave rollback.

anya: I'll mute UX telemetry and monitor frontend errors.

pete: I'll tail runtime metrics and router-standby logs. Note: router-15 reload takes ~20-50s per instance; whitelist rollout may be staggered.

release-bot: preflight summary: smoke OK. Canary config saved in release metadata.

noah: Everyone please ack if you can monitor at 22:30 UTC. If no ack by 22:15 we postpone to next window.

anya: Ack.

pete: Ack, will be watching logs.

deploybot: deploybot: standing by. Will emit events to #release-notifications when wave starts.

noah: Thanks  I'll post a short start note at kickoff and ping on-call.
